title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(藤井健史研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Fujii Takeshi)
keywords: Architectural design/Urban design 2.Urban space analysis 3.Simulation/Programming 4.BIM/xR 5.Regional collaboration
educationalGoal: Students choose either "work" or "thesis" as the framework for their activities, with the following goals: (1) Setting unique issues based on multifaceted analysis of social demands, location, history, etc. (2) To think and propose solutions to the set problems logically. (3) To give a representation the achievement of the project properly.
advice: first semester ・Collecting information and discussing interests related to architecture and cities ・Review of architectural works and previous research ・Setting project theme ・ Acquisition of analysis methods for architectural urban spaces using information technology second semester ・Execution of the project - "Work": site, program, design decision, drawing and model creation - "Paper": Development of research methods, implementation of analysis and experiments, writing of papers ・Present results at the public presentation review meeting of PDIII, and receive evaluation and pass/fail judgment there. others ・Work on project activities in the laboratory.
books: Textbooks:Specify according to theme Reference books:Specify according to theme Reserved books:Specify according to theme
requiredKnowledge: PDIII is a culmination of university learning. In addition to what you have learned in previous classes, please learn knowledge and the latest trends from books and specialized magazines. Also, get into the habit of thinking about architecture and cities on a daily basis, and refine your sense of discovering issues and questions.

activityGoals.body: Students can set goals and activity plans for their own themes, conduct surveys and collect materials.
Students can consider better architecture and environment and make specific proposals and activities.
Students can make proposals and activities that apply information technologies to architectural planning and des
Students can organize the process and results of their activities and create a project report(work/thesis).
Students can give a presentation about the results and key points of the project simply.
Students can consider the project theme associating their own courses after graduation.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students can collect information about a project theme by doing a literature search and field survey based on an awareness of the project problem, and are able to explain not only the problem as a research theme but also the necessity of solving it. Students can apply appropriate approaches to analysis by themselves, and effectively carry out the project according to their plan. They can produce a logical report/ an attractive work of the results and give an effective presentation of the findings to others.
achievementLevels.standard: Students can explain their own awareness of the issues and collect information about a project theme by doing a literature search and field survey. Students can apply appropriate approaches to analysis by themselves and carry out the project. They can create a thesis/a work as a outcome and give a presentation of their findings for others.

lessons.content: For the purpose of setting the project theme and acquiring the ability to carry out the project, we will work on the following. ・Collecting information about interests in architecture and cities discussion ・Review of architectural works and previous research ・ Acquisition of analysis methods for architectural urban spaces using information technology ・Strengthen design and presentation skills by participating in design competitions

Seminars will be held for “thesis” and “work” respectively. (thesis) ・Guidance on experiments, analysis, and thesis writing (work) ・Guidance on concepts, programs, designs, drawings, and model creation
